title: Generalized additive models
html:
Let y1,…,yn be independent from an exponential dispersion family in the sense of @def-glm-model, with dispersion ϕ, variance function V, link g and mean μi=g−1(ηi), and let 𝛈𝛄η=Zγ be the structured additive predictor @eq-add-star with block penalty P as in @eq-add-blockpenalty. Define the penalized deviance 𝛄𝛄𝛄𝛄Q(γ)=D(γ)+γ⊤Pγ,{#eq-add-penlik}

with D the deviance of @def-glm-deviance. Assume that Z⊤WZ+P is positive definite at every iterate and at the limit — the penalty supplies what the basis lacks, as in @prp-add-identifiability — and let 𝛄γ^ be a minimizer of @eq-add-penlik, which then exists and is locally unique.

  1. Minimizing @eq-add-penlik is the same as maximizing the penalized log-likelihood 𝛄𝛄𝛄ℓ(γ)−(2ϕ)−1γ⊤Pγ. Neither the minimizer nor the iteration below depends on ϕ.

  2. (Penalized IRLS.) With W the working weights and z the working response of @eq-glm-working-response, both evaluated at 𝛄γ(t), the Fisher scoring step for @eq-add-penlik is 𝛄γ(t+1)=(Z⊤WZ+P)−1Z⊤Wz,{#eq-add-pirls}

    that is, the penalized weighted least squares fit of the working response on the same design. At a fixed point the unpenalized columns satisfy 𝛍X⊤WD−1(y−μ)=0, where D=diag{h′(ηi)}; for the canonical link with prior weights wi≡1 this is 𝛍X⊤(y−μ)=0.

  3. (Degrees of freedom.) At convergence, with A=Z⊤WZ+P, the effective degrees of freedom are df=tr(A−1Z⊤WZ) and split over terms exactly as in @prp-add-df(b). The approximate covariance of 𝛄γ^ is ϕA−1Z⊤WZA−1 in its frequentist form and ϕA−1 in the Bayesian form of @prp-add-mixed.

  4. (Inference for a term.) Let Vj=ϕ(A−1)jj and let Vjr− be the rank-r pseudo-inverse of Vj with r the integer nearest to dfj. Under fj≡0, and treating 𝛌λ as fixed and ϕ as known, 𝛄𝛄Tj=γ^j⊤Vjr−γ^j has approximately the χ2(r) distribution; with ϕ estimated, Tj/r is referred to F(r,n−df). This is an approximation, stated here without proof; see the notes.
